long_biography.plain_text:
Luciano Grostein Huck entered media after early work in São Paulo nightlife, print and radio. He became nationally known at Bandeirantes before joining Globo in 2000. For 21 years, Caldeirão do Huck combined studio entertainment with outside stories and social-transformation segments, establishing him as one of Brazil's most recognizable television presenters.

In 2021, Huck moved to Sunday afternoons with Domingão com Huck, continuing as a presenter and showrunner. Alongside broadcasting, he built a long-running investment practice through Joá Investimentos and successor vehicles, backing companies in technology, mobility, consumer services and media. He also founded Instituto Criar, which prepares young people for work in audiovisual production and digital technology.
